basic.description:
{Basic Pathfinding}

Basic Pathfinding reduces the movement penalty for rough terrain by 25 points, down to a minimum cost of 95.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Pathfinding}

Advanced Pathfinding reduces the movement penalty for rough terrain by 50 points, down to a minimum cost of 90.

expert.description:
{Expert Pathfinding}

Expert Pathfinding reduces the movement penalty for rough terrain by 75 points, down to a minimum cost of 85.
